highlights.reason_zh: 企业策略与长任务稳定性修复直接影响 coding agent 的升级边界。
highlights.reason_en: Enterprise-policy and long-task stability fixes directly affect coding-agent upgrade decisions.

highlights.reason_zh: M3.1 Flash 从低价 API 扩展到公开权重，自托管选择发生实质变化。
highlights.reason_en: M3.1 Flash moves from a low-cost API to public weights, materially changing self-hosting options.

highlights.reason_zh: GPT-6 Rosalind 把前沿模型带入受限生命科学研究，但可用性和证据边界很窄。
highlights.reason_en: GPT-6 Rosalind brings a frontier model to restricted life-science research with narrow access and evidence boundaries.

highlights.reason_zh: OpenCode 2.2 的持久 PTY 与调度原语会改变长任务工作流，但首发回归提示先小范围试用。
highlights.reason_en: OpenCode 2.2 persistent PTYs and scheduling change long-task workflows, while launch regressions argue for a bounded trial.

highlights.reason_zh: NVIDIA 的 NVFP4 checkpoint 降低 Blackwell 部署门槛，但量化质量仍需实测。
highlights.reason_en: NVIDIA’s NVFP4 checkpoint lowers the Blackwell deployment barrier, but quantized quality still needs testing.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并完成阅读，并主动补查官方博客、GitHub、Hugging Face、arXiv、小团队与非英语材料。GPT-6 Rosalind 只有日期精度；厂商 benchmark 尚未独立复现。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were fully read, supplemented by official blogs, GitHub, Hugging Face, arXiv, small teams and non-English primary material. GPT-6 Rosalind has date-only timing; vendor benchmarks remain independently unreproduced.
